source: lab (real Orbbec Femto Mega recording, background removed with Segment Anything 2 -> black background)

camera.motion: static (no pan/shake; table pixels identical across frames, mean |frame diff| ~0.15 grey levels outside the ball)
camera.perspective: camera slightly above table height looking at a square table from a corner-ish oblique view; table top is a foreshortened quadrilateral, depth increases upward in the image. Ball rolls left->right along the near half of the table, image y increasing 488->512 (slightly toward the camera).

ball.description: white / cream ball (ping-pong-ball-like), the only moving object
ball.reference_point: visible centre: x = template-match centre, y = midpoint of top and bottom edges

apparent_size_px.vertical_diameter: 33-34 at rest (frames 0-11, x~278), 36-38 in frames 15-29 (x 410-640), 34-36 in frames 36-48 (x 770-966); underside is shaded and blends with the table, so heights may be ~2-4 px short
apparent_size_px.horizontal_width_static: 40-42 (frames 0-11; left edge partly cut by segmentation)
apparent_size_px.horizontal_width_moving: 48-53 incl. ~16 px/frame motion blur; not a size measure

pink_bottle.description: tall pale-pink cylindrical thermos bottle, back-centre of table, left of the cup
pink_bottle.note: bottom partly hidden behind the standing card

white_cup.description: white tumbler/cup (wider at the top), right of the pink bottle

standing_card.description: playing card leaning against the pink bottle (white with grey-blue pattern)

lying_cards.description: two/three playing cards lying flat on the table in front of the bottle/cup; the ball passes in front of / over them in frames 29-35

dark_card.description: dark navy card / phone-like flat object lying near the front edge, with a yellow sticker at its right end

yellow_sticker.description: yellow label on the dark card

table.description: square wooden table, brown top, single dark pedestal leg

table_leg.description: dark grey cylindrical pedestal leg below the table centre
table_leg.note: cut by the bottom image border

events.name: ball at rest at the left end of the table
start of motion (launch)
events.note: motion begins between frames 11 and 12; first step is ~48 px, steps then shrink 33, 28, 25, 19, 16 px and stay ~16 px/frame from frame 17 on. No hand visible (segmented out).

events.name: ball passes in front of the lying playing cards
probable dropped capture frame
events.note: x step 32.7 px vs ~16 px in neighbouring frames, container timestamps are uniform

events.name: end of clip, ball still rolling right
